dedupe_keys.name: planned extra high voltage transmission lines in germany grid development plan 2021

description: This small data set lists planned extra-high-voltage AC and DC transmission lines in Germany, compiled by hand from the second draft of the 2021 grid development plan (Netzentwicklungsplan) of the German transmission system operators. It was published on Zenodo in August 2024 (version 0.0.1) by Clara Büttner for the eGon-data processing tool, within the hybit research project funded by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research. Besides the lists of planned lines, a shapefile gives the existing lines that the new lines will replace, so that future grid topologies can be built. Coverage is Germany. The data are one zipped archive, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the lists follow a draft plan from 2021 and are not updated for later plans, and they were made for one tool's inputs. Simulation uses are future-grid power flow and capacity expansion scenarios for Germany. Related records: data-egon-data is the tool that uses these inputs.
name: Planned extra-high-voltage transmission lines in Germany (grid development plan 2021)
